skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Waverider WR04
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Waverider Series WR04. This swimsuit tailor-made for Ægir beachgoers allows inhabitants of the sea to look dazzling on the sand.
skins.quote: The hunters of the sea still do not understand why they need to don the strange attire of landlubbers.

skins.name: The Next Afternoon Tea
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/The Next Afternoon Tea. Tailored to fit snugly from lightweight hydrophobic fabric, ensuring the wearer is unhindered in water. Made to measure for Ægir residing on the land.
skins.quote: The day's work is done, and it's time to buy some snacks from the street-side shops for a comfortable afternoon at home. The snacks available now are different than before, but the people enjoying them still are the same.
